verdict.rationale: Parahelp documents human-in-the-loop guardrails for the Customer Agent: any tool can be gated behind approval, with gated actions sent to Slack and nothing running until someone approves. It also offers simulations against historical tickets so you can see behavior before customers do. However, the evidence shows approval gating for tool actions like refunds, not a supervised mode where the agent's customer-facing replies are held as drafts for human review. The Internal Agent's default manual approval applies to configuration actions, not customer replies. Missing for 10: explicit draft-reply or copilot mode where every outbound customer message needs human approval, documented rollout from supervised to autonomous replies, independent or hands-on corroboration.
